ModMetaData.name: DMS Synthetic Apparel Repair
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description: DMS Synthetic is optional. When it is installed, eligible Synthetic pawns can repair worn apparel; otherwise this mod provides weapon repair for eligible DMS and integrated weapon-capable mechs. The in-game mod settings let you enable or disable apparel and weapon repair independently and adjust their energy cost. Apparel and non-standard weapons default to one tenth of MechEnergyLossPerHP per repaired hit point; AutomatroidWeapon durability repair remains free by default and is configurable.
